summary: Story roll-up for assistant on the merged tree. The aggregate D-0008 host proof runs test:warehouse-proof 20/20 with 0 failures and 0 skipped, and the dead-port control at WAREHOUSE_PG_PORT=5599 fails 8 gated leaves with 16 ECONNREFUSED while the 12 ungated ones still pass - so the green run is real database work, not skips. The app-DB migration proof this story introduced runs 1/1 on the host. Two performance-shaped decisions are load-bearing and were verified live rather than assumed: re-running a saved selection BYPASSES the model (1434ms for the Bedrock ask vs 38ms for the re-run of the same selection, model_id NULL in the audit row), and pinned dashboard cards are metadata-only, so loading the dashboard performs NO governed execution - exactly 2 /api/chat calls existed across the whole live session and the dashboard added none. Refusal audits on a listing go out in one batched insert rather than a serial insert per refused row.
